notes.title: REDNIGHT BÊTA
notes.content:
Red Night enters Beta!
Here are the additions in this new version:

- Smoke and fog system when pipes are hit by gunfire
- Improved flashlights for the M4 and Glock
- Ammo system:
- Reloading causes you to lose any remaining bullets in the magazine
- A key lets you check your remaining magazines (Tess will tell you)
- Ammo is now assigned to each weapon (M4 / Glock)
- Improved glowstick torches
- Added new corridors: house ↔ garage / basement ↔ basement, to prevent dead ends for the monster
- Introduction improved and polished
- New monster
- Horde system
- Flamethrower (attached under the M4)
- Radial menu
- Camera VFX
- New basement
- New voice lines from Tess
- New audio effects
- Controller vibration support
- Explosives (Level 1 Finale)
- Various additions
- General optimizations and improvements
- Numerous bug fixes (Huge thanks to the testers who helped eliminate bugs you'll never have to face!)

Coming in the next update:
- Fully localized subtitle system (English, Spanish, German)
- Level 1 Grand Finale and transition to Level 2
- Implementation of all player feedback

See you soon… and happy hunting!

notes.title: REDNIGHT pre-beta
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860423/3b4c792d8d48845b1e8b714b3299cc727b91b2bf.png[/img]

[b]REDNIGHT enters pre-beta![/b]
[b]
Additions:[/b]
• New menu
• Steam Deck compatibility
• DLSS - FSR - TSR
• Fully playable with a controller (Xbox - PS5)
• Available translations: English - Spanish - French
• Performance: 100 FPS on ultra (RTX 2070 Super)
• Complete audio control system
• Compatibility with Linux - Mac - Switch
• Management of anti-aliasing, Lumen, quality settings, post-process...
• Glowsticks change color based on their battery level.
• Fully remappable inputs (keyboard / mouse / gamepad)
• New audio branch for Tess's voice-over
• Groom optimization
• Cloth simulation management for Level 2
• Adaptive graphics settings menu per level, with preset slots
• Improved M4
• Enhanced weapon and flashlight system

[b]Fixes:[/b]
• Improved performance and sub-level management
• Fixed a bug where you could see through Tess when turning
• Fixed the "running in place" bug
• Fixed weapon disappearance (shot/stick) depending on action sequences
• Fixed the monster not adapting to dynamic navigation
• Fixed the monster's hair
• Various other bugs have also been fixed

[b]What's next?[/b]
I’m starting the implementation of the Level 1 storyline
(testers will receive versions this week and next week)

• Multilingual translation
• Subtitle language and size management
• Addition of a L4D-style directional cross

Happy hunting!
